result.finding: Public/Internal data only. The application stores photo images (binary BLOB) and associated metadata (filename, size, dimensions, upload timestamp). No PII, PHI, PCI, or confidential business data detected.
evidence: Photo entity fields: id (UUID), originalFileName, storedFileName, filePath, fileSize, mimeType, uploadedAt, width, height, photoData (BLOB)
No user identity fields (no username, email, address, phone)
No payment or financial data fields
No health or medical data fields
No formal data classification policy documented in README or docs
Database credentials hardcoded in docker-compose.yml represent internal configuration data
values: Data types: photo images (BLOB), photo metadata (filename, size, dimensions, timestamp)
Configuration data (DB passwords) classified as Internal/Confidential
